title: WOMBO COMBO
blurb: 'OH! WOMBO COMBO!' — the ecstatic commentary from a legendary Super Smash Bros. tournament clip that became gaming's original hype meme. The pure, cracking-voiced joy of it is timeless. Play it when anything chains together perfectly: combos, plans, or a sequence of events that shouldn't have worked but did.
origin: From the legendary Super Smash Bros. Melee 'Wombo Combo' clip.
